# Fengshui Balance (ฮวงจุ้ย สมดุลแห่งธรรมชาติ)

> Professional, balanced Fengshui consultation for homes, businesses, offices, factories, and auspicious shrine placement in Thailand, led by Ajarn Suppachai Vivattanaprasert with 30+ years of field experience.

Fengshui Balance bridges classical San Yuan (Three Cycles) / Xuan Kong Flying Star Fengshui principles with real-world architectural design, natural lighting, air circulation, and modern living.

## Primary Entities & Lineage

- **Lead Consultant:** Ajarn Suppachai Vivattanaprasert (อาจารย์สุภชัย วิวัฒนะประเสริฐ)
  - 30+ years practical consultation experience across Thailand and Southeast Asia.
  - Specialization: Xuan Kong Flying Star (ดาวเหิน 9 ยุค), San Yuan (ซำง้วน), Form School / Landform (ชัยภูมิ), Bazi Chinese Astrology (ดวงจีน ปาจื่อ), and Auspicious Date Selection (ฤกษ์ยามมงคล).
  - Co-founder of Aviva Spirit (luxury modern marble spirit houses with Thai patents #374357 & #1402003308).
- **Master & Mentor:** Ajarn Grianggrai Boontaganon (อาจารย์เกรียงไกร บุญธกานนท์)
  - Founder and President of the Geohorology Club of Thailand (ชมรมภูมิโหราศาสตร์) and Hoolin Foundation (มูลนิธิฮูลิน).

## Core Services

- **Residential Fengshui (ฮวงจุ้ยบ้านและคอนโด):** Directional compass alignment, bedroom placement, kitchen fire-water harmony, main entrance Qi flow, and family well-being.
- **Commercial & Corporate Fengshui (ฮวงจุ้ยธุรกิจและออฟฟิศ):** Executive desk positioning, cash register placement, staff productivity flow, conference room acoustics, and financial growth Qi.
- **Factory & Industrial Fengshui (ฮวงจุ้ยโรงงานและโกดัง):** Heavy machinery placement, vehicle access flow, warehouse organization, safety Qi, and project site master planning.
- **Spirit Shrine Consultation (ตี่จู้เอี๊ยะและศาลพระภูมิ):** Millimeter-exact placement according to Lu Ban ruler dimensions, 5-element balance, and fire-safety electrical integration.
- **Bazi & Auspicious Date Selection (ดวงจีนและฤกษ์มงคล):** Housewarming, groundbreaking, renovation, and shrine installation dates calculated specifically for property owners.
